notes.title: Blue Toad Murder Files Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Blue Toad Murder Files have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

  • Check added to prerequisites package when first installing without .NET 2.0 SP2
  • Launcher bug fix where it was crashing on serialisation with some anti-virus software

notes.title: New Release - Blue Toad Murder Files™: The Mysteries of Little Riddle
notes.notes:
Blue Toad Murder Files™: The Mysteries of Little Riddle is now available on Steam!

As one of the detectives in the Blue Toad Detective Agency, follow the clues and solve the murder mystery in the sleepy village of Little Riddle.

Enjoy 10% off until December 10th at 10 am Pacific Time.
